$comment: Third-party repositories used to validate AI Shipcheck against real code.
These repositories are NOT vendored. `npm run corpus:sync` clones each one
into a cache directory outside this repository and checks out the exact
commit recorded here, so a validation run is reproducible.
`commit` is filled in by `npm run corpus:sync -- --pin` and must be
committed. A null commit means the repository has not been pinned yet.
Every project here is public and permissively licensed for source
inspection. Shipcheck only ever reads their files as text; nothing in them
